youtube_description:
This video documents the ~5 mile (one way) hike from the Stecoah Gap parking area to the top of Cheoah Bald to meet some friends who were hiking there via the Bartram Trail. I was a bit disappointed that it wasn't as bald as what I consider to be a "bald-face mountain," but it did have a nice view from one open part. The stars, of course, were still to die for! I can't believe my google pixel 2XL can pick up stars!!!

Hiking alone is so doable! For any females out there who are afraid to, send me a message, write a comment. I'm happy to encourage!

Here is a link to All Trails: https://www.alltrails.com/trail/us/north-carolina/cheoah-bald-via-appalachian-trail

As always, practice Leave No Trace principles when hiking! www.advenchatera.com/leave-no-trace-principles

If you want to know what I recommend for a backpacking trip, go here: www.advenchatera.com/backpacking-gear-list

I hope you are enjoying my videos and have subscribed to my channel. Turn on the notification bell to always be up to date on my latest video! I do my best to post every Thursday at 3 PM EST.

What I used to shoot & edit this video:
Google Pixel 2XL: https://amzn.to/3nauT4l
Flexible Tripod: https://amzn.to/344FrJV
Yeti Microphone: https://amzn.to/2KbBug9
